_comment: Up NEPA! story missions (docs/story/02-mission-list.md). Run by story/mission_runner.gd. Positions: landmark:<id>, node:<id> (data/map/lagos.json), room:<hotspot> (interiors), npc:<id>. All dialogue lives in dialogue.json and is pending native-speaker review.

missions.title: Arrive in Style
missions.summary: Drive four owambe guests from Ojota to the Royal Pavilion Event Centre in Lekki before the couple's entrance.
missions.fail_line: Na the road wey cause am. Road no get sense.

panels.text: Lagos. Saturday. Somewhere in Lekki, an owambe is loading…

steps.text: Drive with the joystick (or WASD). Tunde's Blood Pressure (BP) rises in go-slow and when people annoy him. At 100 he stops the bus to argue. Keep it cool.
Drive the guests toward the Third Mainland Bridge
Cross the Third Mainland Bridge
LARDO checkpoint ahead. Slow down…
Conductor Combo: tap SULE, then pick the call that fits. Wardens love VIPs.
Use the Conductor Combo: the right call gets you waved through
Reach the Royal Pavilion before the couple's entrance
steps.fail_text: The couple don enter without your guests. Madam is calling her lawyer.

missions.title: Jollof Diplomacy
missions.summary: Serve the jollof rush without running out, and stop the double-dippers.
missions.fail_line: Write it down. I don't forget.

panels.text: Meanwhile, at the buffet, Ngozi "Aunty Boss" Eze is catering. The jollof queue is politics.

steps.text: The Stare: walk close to someone and tap STARE. They freeze and start confessing. Aura (her reputation) makes it last longer.
Use The Stare on the "groom's cousin from abroad"
Serve 30 plates. Elders first. No double-dipping.
steps.fail_text: The jollof finished before the elders ate. Scandal!

missions.title: Content Is Content
missions.summary: Film three viral moments: the MC, the money spraying and the gele competition.
missions.fail_line: Guys… guys? Is this thing on?

steps.text: Hold FILM to record. Keep the subject close and in frame. Filming drains your Battery, so watch it.
Viral moment 1/3: film the MC
Viral moment 2/3: the money spraying. Tap on the beat!
steps.fail_text: Off-beat spraying. The comments are brutal.

steps.text: Viral moment 3/3: film the gele competition

missions.title: NEPA Take Light
missions.summary: Two seconds of blackout. Each hero does one thing. Then the light returns and the bag is gone.

params.prompt: Tunde: someone is touching your pocket. Secure the danfo keys!
Aunty Boss: forty hands are reaching for the jollof. Protect the pot!
KC: total darkness. Content! Turn on the phone light and record!

steps.text: UP NEPAAAA!

Free roam is open. Hustle for money, eat, sleep. Story missions are the gold stars on the map. Open the phone and tap SWITCH to play as Tunde, Aunty Boss or KC: each of them has their own Act 1 mission.

missions.title: Baba God Dey
missions.summary: A day of passengers with strong opinions. One pays "next time" and leaves a bag under seat 4.
missions.fail_line: Na the road wey cause am. Road no get sense.

steps.text: Enter Baba God Dey
Loop 1: Oshodi → Obalende with 12 passengers
Loop 2: back to Oshodi over the bridge
Go-slow on the bridge…
Go-Slow Whisperer: tap WHISPER. Time slows, and for a few seconds Baba God Dey finds the gaps in traffic that nobody else can see.
Use Go-Slow Whisperer
Bring the passengers home to Oshodi

panels.text: Under seat 4: a Ghana-must-go bag. Heavy. The music cuts.

missions.title: Ajo Day
missions.summary: Collect ajo from six market women while the POS network keeps failing.
missions.fail_line: Write it down. I don't forget.

steps.text: Collect ajo contributions
Run the POS through the network failures
steps.fail_text: The queue rioted. Comedically, but still.

missions.title: Four Percent
missions.summary: The blackout clip is at 40,000 viewers. KC's phone is at 4%. Find power before it dies.

steps.text: The stream is live and your battery is dying. Find power: the barbershop generator, the church inverter, the charging kiosk.
Find power before the phone dies
Run! Lose Pepper and hide somewhere safe
steps.caught_text: Pepper caught KC. "Like and subscribe!" did not work.

missions.title: Who Get This Bag?
missions.summary: Get the bag somewhere safe before the Chief's people spot the yellow danfo.

steps.text: Escape Pepper and Salt. Hide the bus at the Mushin mechanic
steps.caught_text: Pepper and Salt blocked the danfo. They argued about jollof long enough for you to retry.

missions.title: Family Meeting
missions.summary: All three in Aunty Boss's canteen at night, the bag on the table, the generator roaring.

panels.text: Aunty Boss Kitchen. 9 p.m. No light. One generator. One bag. Three people who do not trust each other.

steps.text: The generator is LOUD. When the noise peaks, hold SHOUT to be heard or you lose the line.
Get your points across over the generator
steps.fail_text: Nobody heard anybody. Food is ready, though. Try again.

steps.text: Count it first. Fast, before someone "helps".

Family Meeting 🔥 is now in your phone: switch between Tunde, Aunty Boss and KC any time in free roam. Act 2, "Spread", is open: three missions, any order. Hidden diary pages are now scattered around Lagos, too.

missions.title: Generator Wars
missions.summary: Move a 60 kVA generator from Mushin to the canteen at night, past rival streets defending their own.
missions.fail_line: SLIPPERS! (You have been slippered. Try again.)

steps.text: Pushing a generator is SLOW. Rival lookouts throw slippers if you get close while they're watching: keep your distance, and use Aunty's Stare to freeze them.
Push the generator past the rival street without being seen
steps.caught_text: Slippered! The rivals are guarding the generator now. Try again.

steps.text: The Stare: freeze Oga Slippers
Last stretch: get the generator to the canteen
steps.caught_text: A whole street of slippers. KC's ring light did not survive. Try again.

panels.text: The generator coughs. Roars. And every street within a kilometre gets light.

missions.title: Japa Interview
missions.summary: KC's visa interview at the fictional Republic of Northvale. The officer never blinks.
missions.fail_line: Guys… guys? The officer is still staring.

panels.text: Embassy of the Republic of Northvale. Window 4. The officer has not blinked since 2019.

steps.text: Stay composed. Answer quickly. Do not mention the goat unless asked.

missions.title: Danfo Chase
missions.summary: Pepper and Salt chase Tunde through go-slow with 14 passengers who vote on every turn.

steps.text: Lose Pepper and Salt: get to Surulere
steps.caught_text: Boxed in! Pepper and Salt argued about jollof long enough for a retry.

missions.title: Aso-Ebi Infiltration
missions.summary: Get into Mama Chief's 90th birthday in the right aso-ebi, survive the aunties and find Barrister Ledger's study.
missions.fail_line: "When are you marrying?" (You fled. Try again.)

steps.text: Match the invitation card at the gate
steps.fail_text: "Madam, you are NOT on the list." Try again.

panels.text: Mama Chief's 90th. Purple everywhere. Aunties everywhere. Questions everywhere.

steps.text: Greet the celebrant (it would be rude not to)
Distract everybody: DANCE
steps.fail_text: KC danced off-beat. The aunties are now teaching him. Try again.

steps.text: While KC dances, slip into the house: Barrister Ledger's study
steps.fail_text: An aunty caught Tunde: "Who are you to the family?" Try again.

missions.title: Following the Money
missions.summary: Trace how Barrister Ledger split the Chief's cash across POS agents. Collect evidence; launder nothing.
missions.fail_line: Write it down. I don't forget. (Try again.)

steps.text: Talk to the POS agents
Build the investigation board
steps.fail_text: The red string is a mess. Mama Nkem is laughing. Try again.

missions.title: Fuel Queue Standoff
missions.summary: Diesel for the canteen generator at the only open PetroNaija station. The queue is a war.
missions.fail_line: Bonked by a jerrycan. Comedically. Try again.

steps.text: The Stare: the pump attendant says there's "no fuel"
A convoy skipped the queue. Brawl! Dodge the jerrycans
steps.fail_text: You got bonked. Many times. Try again.

missions.title: Viral
missions.summary: Use Gist and Go Live to turn the ward's opinion about the Chief. True gists stick; lies come back to bite.

steps.text: Seed the gists. Only the ones with receipts.

missions.title: Midpoint: Old Money
missions.summary: A full count of the bag. The twist: it's mostly old notes. The real prize is the diary.

steps.text: The full count. Every note.

panels.text: Old notes. Withdrawn years ago. The Chief has been hoarding worthless paper.

steps.text: Act 3, "Election Day", is open. The ward votes soon: every bloc you win over counts.

missions.title: Campaign Season
missions.summary: Drive Teacher's campaign around the ward. Win the blocs honestly; bribes always backfire.
missions.fail_line: Teacher: "We go again. Democracy is a marathon."

steps.text: Campaign stops (any order)

missions.title: The Debate
missions.summary: Get Teacher into the radio debate, make sure the Chief can't skip it, and win the room.

steps.text: Win the debate: receipts beat slogans
steps.fail_text: The Chief's slogans won the room. Try again.

missions.title: Light Man
missions.summary: Find Engineer Bayo and pay him in suya to bring the light back at exactly the right second.
missions.fail_line: The suya went cold. Bayo is a professional. Try again.

steps.text: Find Engineer Bayo at the Light & Darkness substation
Get THE suya from Mallam Garba in Victoria Island
steps.fail_text: Mallam Garba sold out. To Officer Gbenga, of all people. Try again.

steps.text: Back to Bayo before the shift change. The suya must be HOT
steps.fail_text: Shift change. The new lineman only accepts bank transfer. Try again.

missions.title: Up NEPA!
missions.summary: The rally. Blackout as the Chief begins. On cue, the light returns: every light, speaker and phone.
missions.fail_line: The light came back too early. Bayo is upset. Try again.

panels.text: Agbado-Ketu Central Mini Stadium. The Chief's final rally. The light goes off as he begins. As planned.

steps.text: Tunde: block the convoy exit with Baba God Dey
steps.fail_text: The convoy got out. Try again.

steps.text: Aunty Boss: take the spare mic
steps.fail_text: Someone else grabbed the mic. It was the MC. Try again.

steps.text: KC: GO LIVE
On the second the Chief takes the stage: UP NEPA!
steps.fail_text: The cues were off. Bayo signals: again.

steps.text: UP NEPAAAA!

panels.text: Every floodlight. Every speaker. Every phone. And on every screen: the diary.

missions.title: Epilogue
missions.summary: How it ends depends on everything you chose.

panels.text: Ending A · Honest. The money becomes a transformer and a borehole. Baba God Dey becomes the ward shuttle.
Ending B · Hustle. The old notes went to "a guy". The guy was the FCIB.
Ending C · Japa. Northvale is cold. The video calls are warm.
Ending D · Secret. The last page of the diary names someone above the Chief.

NAIJA STREET LIFE
UP NEPA!
· THE END ·

steps.text: Story complete! Your story money (₦s) has joined your wallet. Lagos keeps living: hustle, switch heroes, find what you missed. Replay the story from the phone to try another ending.

Diary page! "Paid the agberos to 'love' the Chief. They loved the money."
Diary page! "Owambe budget: ₦9m. Jollof: ₦0 (Aunty never got paid)."
